text:
nina: Quick check-in after the failover postmortem. We need a compact tracker for owners, small test plans, and concrete rollback gates before the next rehearsal. Can we capture in-thread?

raj: I'll take the routing rollback automation. My plan is: small Lambda to flip weights + health check, then a safety gate in the orchestrator to auto-rollback if p50 or p95 exceed thresholds. Target: 1866080000.

sophie: Thanks @raj. I'll pair on the health checks (endpoint + DB probe). Can we add a synthetic that exercises a typical inference request?

raj: Yes, synthetic will use sample prompt set. I'll post the test vectors.

ben: I'll own backup verification and an example restore. Outline: verify cross-region replication TTL, then do a staged restore from eu-west snapshots into a sandbox account and validate application start. Target: 1866045000. Ticket: INF-7901 (link after I create).

nina: Add these to remediation board and tag with `regional-recovery`. Also need someone on runbook choreography: step-by-step timed checklist + who calls who.

ops-bot: Created ticket: https://jira.internal/INF-7901 (owner: ben, due: 1866045000). Calendar placeholder: "regional-recovery rehearsal" at 1866160000.

infra-bot: New follow-ups: followup/1866004321-routing-rollback (owner: raj, due: 1866080000), followup/1866004321-backup-verify (owner: ben, due: 1866045000).

sophie: For the runbook, I'll draft a choreography section with explicit timings and communication checks. Example snippet to include:```
1) Notify on-call -> 0 min
2) Start traffic shift stage 1 (10%) -> 2 min
3) Validate p95 and error_rate -> 5 min
4) Proceed to next stage or rollback -> automated gate
```

nina: Good. Also, we noticed a recurring pattern: several incidents had publish queue saturation before backup lag spikes. Can we add a query to surface queue growth against replication lag for the last 6 months?

ben: I'll add an Observability dashboard panel: publish_queue_depth vs replication_lag (6m). Will include deploy annotations.

raj: For rollback gates, proposal: abort if p95 > 600ms OR 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained for 3m. Also introduce a gradual cooldown between stages (2m) to let caches warm.

sophie: I'll add the config snippet to the runbook:```
routing_cutover:
  stages: [10, 30, 60, 100]
  cooldown_secs: 120
  rollback_conditions:
    - p95_latency_ms > 600
    - error_rate_5xx_pct > 0.8
```

nina: Action list (short):
- routing rollback automation: raj -> 1866080000
- backup verification + sandbox restore: ben -> 1866045000
- restore runbook choreography draft: sophie -> 1866030000
- dashboard for queue vs lag: ben -> 1866050000
- game-day rehearsal notice/calendar: ops-bot -> 1866160000

raj: I'll open a small PR for the orchestrator with test hooks and a simulated traffic replay job. PR will point to synthetic vectors from the test harness.

ben: Confirmed INF-7901 created and assigned to me. Link: https://jira.internal/INF-7901. I'll paste restore logs into the ticket once done.

nina: One more ask: whoever runs the rehearsal, please record a short runbook-run video and drop to the remediation board so product and support can see the steps.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "regional-recovery rehearsal" at 1866160000. Invitees: nina, raj, sophie, ben, oncall.

sophie: I'll finish the choreography draft by EOD Fri. Putting the branch `runbook/recovery-choreo` up.

raj: Noted. If any owner needs to move dates, ping here. Otherwise we'll treat these as committed.

nina: Thanks team. We'll review status in next incident-owners sync. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
